verdict.rationale: An email client with a built-in AI assistant could plausibly act as an MCP client, so this axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence shows Outlook accepting or plugging in MCP servers. The only MCP mention (outlook-comm-13) describes an external LLM using an MCP integration to search email, which is the reverse direction and does not count toward this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
